_doc: Khuôn Reels (docs/specs/social-reels-templates.md): Ama/Carlos đọc mẫu tiếng Anh ≤150 wpm, chừa lặng cho người xem đọc theo (repeat), IPA lấy từ kho từ lúc dựng, chữ bản địa viết tay (native-qa).

segments.text: It means, do not worry, it is fine.
Sorry, I am late. No problem!

native.caption: 别人道歉时，你只会说“It’s OK”吗？试试更地道的“No problem.”，意思是没问题、别担心。例如：“Sorry, I am late.”——“No problem!” 听 Ama 老师示范，再在停顿时跟读。更多练习在 Lexkite 应用。

en.hook: What else can you say for "it is fine"?
en.caption: When someone says sorry, do you only say “It’s OK”? Try the more natural “No problem.”, which means no problem, do not worry. Example: “Sorry, I am late.” – “No problem!” Listen to Ama, then repeat in the pause. More practice is in the Lexkite app.
